scope: Web-only UI release; no production environment, database, profile, or secret reads
workflow: Complete and review the UI delta; record the merged source commit before release build.
Run scripts/stage-food-ui.py to verify/copy exactly the previous 573 public files and three named UI donors.
Build the isolated source candidate with the verified dependency inputs; do not load production environment or profiles.

Run scripts/package-food-ui.py to verify the previous full release manifest, copy standalone/public/static/catalog files, remove its exact known node_modules symlink, then materialize the 9,893 verified dependency files from the frozen release.
Run scripts/deploy-food-ui.py audit --write-manifest; review the public manifest fingerprint, exact inventory, source evidence, and service pins.
After independent review, run prepare with the reviewed manifest SHA, then apply. The helper adds one later-sorting ExecStart-only drop-in and restarts only baby-panel.service.
Verify Web readiness and require all six protected unit MainPIDs to match their pre-apply values; use the helper rollback if Web readiness or pin checks fail.
safetyConstraints: Do not read production environment files, secrets, or private profiles; do not connect to production databases.
The pinned 573-file public source set includes lib/llm-profiles.ts source code; no profile data or configuration files are staged or packaged.
Do not copy databases, uploads, backups, user records, or private runtime files.
Preserve the six existing drop-ins and verify their hashes before every systemd mutation.
Require the exact two prior public SDK file hashes; unknown files and modified SDK files are refused.
Rollback retains the new immutable release and removes only this task's receipt-owned drop-in.
